frame_image_note: Video co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) o dau: frame 0-8 san pham dung tren nen beige tron (chua co hieu ung), vach sang quet tu trai sang phai trong khoang frame 9-20, quet het va lo ra day du mat nuoc vang long lanh o ~frame 21-22/129 (24fps). Lay frame 22 lam base.png: luc do toan bo nen la mat chat long vang gon song, san pham + bong phan chieu da hien day du, khong con vet quet, va con som so voi dang gon song ban dau (chua bi cac vong gon song/anh sang dich chuyen qua nhieu).
effect_prompt: A pool of molten liquid gold ripples gently beneath and around the product, with soft concentric ripples slowly spreading and shifting across the glossy surface. Warm diagonal streaks of bright light slowly sweep across the liquid gold background, creating shifting highlights and reflections over time. A glossy mirror-like reflection of the product shimmers on the rippling golden surface below. The camera stays completely fixed throughout, with no camera movement, no pan, no zoom; warm golden studio lighting, photorealistic advertisement cinematography, consistent composition.
effect_prompt_note: So sanh cac frame 22/30/45/60/75/90/105/120/128: khung hinh, vi tri san pham va duong chan deu khong doi -> camera co dinh, khong pan/zoom/xoay. Hieu ung nen la mat chat long vang gon song lien tuc + vung sang cheo quet/dich chuyen qua lai tren be mat (giong anh sang phan chieu di dong), cuong do khong tang dan ro ret ma chi bien doi tuan hoan -- khac voi smoky-pedestal (khoi day dan). Khong phat hien chuyen dong camera nao, chi co chuyen dong cua chat long/anh sang.
image_prompt: Replace the entire tube in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.
image_prompt_note: Viet lai 2026-10 LAN 2 theo cong thuc da duoc NGUOI DUNG tu tay xac nhan hoat dong tren golden-fireworks (ca KHO NHAT, 5 lan thu truoc deu that bai): 'Replace the entire X in the first image with the product from the second image, maintaining the second product's original size, proportions, and colors.' Day la cau LENH TRUC TIEP (imperative 'Replace'), ngan gon, KHONG mo ta vi tri/scene/anh sang gi them -- bang chung cho thay day moi la yeu to quyet dinh (khong phai tranh phu dinh nhu ket luan LAN 1 truoc do, vi ban 'tich cuc' lan 1 van that bai tren chinh golden-fireworks).
